card.name: Words before government agency names
card.fires_on: Small words like "the", "US", "U.S." or "States" right before the name of a government agency, especially Geological Survey. Also some words before place names near an earthquake.

modes.label: Before Geological Survey
modes.description: The, US, U.S. or States just ahead of "Geological Survey" in earthquake news.
modes.example: The<< US>> Geological Survey said the quake occurred at

modes.label: Before other agency names
modes.description: The or US just before a federal agency or service name in a list or story.
modes.example: US Fish and Wildlife Service (Department of the Interior), -<< US>> Maritime Administration (Department of Transportation), -

modes.label: Before a place after a quake
modes.description: A linking word such as "in" or "facing" just before a place name.
modes.example: producing over one hundred aftershocks from its epicenter<< in>> Tabanli.
